d:
Experience the soulful melodies of renowned flautist Jagdish Verman in the Raag Sudha Ras programme. Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Indian classical music, accompanied by a talented ensemble of musicians.
Accompanying Artists:
Bansuri: Jamuna Prasad Verman
Tabla: Somnath Mukherjee
Harmonium: Jitendra
Tanpura: Swapn Vishwash
A musical journey celebrating the timeless beauty of Indian classical music.
